notes: 1.5.1: stock openai-python headers (no litellm, so no x-stainless-raw-response). Each role has a hard-coded prompt opening: 'You are ShellGPT' (default), 'You are Shell Command Generator' (-s), 'You are Shell Command Descriptor' (-d), 'You are Code Generator' (-c); the OS and shell names follow and vary. Function calling (OPENAI_USE_FUNCTIONS, --install-functions) adds the single tool execute_shell_command with tool_choice auto and parallel_tool_calls false; the -s/-d/-c roles send no tools, so headers plus identity carry those. temperature 0.0 and top_p 1.0 on every request. Identical on the first turn, after the tool call and on the --chat <id> follow-up. The response cache must be off (--no-cache) or repeated prompts never reach the API.
